scopeNotes: All 35 top-level map SWFs were exported; 28 lack a sibling XFL DOMDocument. This is script inspection, not live reachability of every placement.
Known loader patterns were searched in actual bytecode exports. Dynamic expressions, unrelated art/movie SWFs and live visual/input behavior are not globally proved absent.
No-XFL UI script excerpts are persisted here so the conclusions do not depend solely on local tmp exports.
One old B/C row maps once; container and component rows are not additive product counts. Work estimates are judgment under stated scope, not measured throughput.
Existing unrelated reward-stash worktree changes were present; this snapshot does not claim they are promoted.

laneCompletion.surfaces: report saved; final-response prefix observed; trailing CLI stream did not finish, so only the verified task process tree was stopped during cleanup

orchestration.limits: Agent reports are research leads. Parent verification overruled several reachability and estimate claims; their conclusions are not accepted wholesale.
